newsitem.title: ZAIRE: United States advises citizens to avoid Zaire.
newsitem.headline: United States advises citizens to avoid Zaire.

text.p: The United States has advised its citizens to avoid travelling to Zaire and has called on Americans already in the anarchic Central African country to consider leaving.

A State Department advisory note, dated Tuesday and obtained by Reuters on Wednesday, spoke of "an unsettling period" in Zaire and its capital Kinshasa, which is over 1,200 km (800 miles) from the war zone in the east.
"We advise Americans to defer all travel to Zaire," it said. "This would be a good time for Americans in Zaire to review security precautions during this period of uncertainty."
Diplomatic sources said embassy staff in Kinshasa had been authorised by the State Department to allow family and dependants to leave Zaire at government expense.
Expatriates in Kinshasa fear panic and violence in the capital if the army loses the impending battle for Zaire's third city of Kisangani.
